title: What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math
question:
What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math average? Indicate the school's name.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Postal street and mailing street are synonyms.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_045, s.XCL_046
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
ORDER BY t.XCL_036 DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_053 || ' - ' || s.XCL_047
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
WHERE t.XCL_038 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.XCL_038 DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;
